title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.4

topic.reason: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, RAG- und Agentensysteme (Treffer: ollama, embedding, mlx, inference, server)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.4): ## Decision models in the CLI Decision models can now be used directly from the terminal with `ollama run` — ask yes/no questions, classify text into labels, or score against a rubric: `ollama run nimble --ask "Is a refund being requested?" < ticket.txt` ## What's Changed * Kev decision models are now supported by the MLX runner on Apple silicon * `ollama launch` can now be used with usage credits without upgrading to a paid plan * `ollama launch codex` now includes locally installed Ollama models in its model picker. Use `/model` within the Codex CLI to swap models. * Improved inference performance by reusing verified manifests and already loaded models * Added support for multimodal embeddings through llama-server * Fixed loading multimodal embedding models with small context windows * Improved Gemma 4 prefill performance on NVIDIA GPUs with the MLX runner * MLX runner now clips long Laya states instead of rejecting them * Improved speculative decoding reliability in the MLX runner,
